menu_options.yaml_import: Import a composed device from YAML

single.title: Add an emulated device
single.description: Pick the Home Assistant domain to emulate.

show_as.title: Show as
show_as.description: This domain covers more than one real device class - pick which one to show it as.

image_source.title: Image source
image_source.description: Enter an image URL (http:// or https://), or a path relative to your www folder (served at /local/), e.g. "myphoto.jpg".

options.title: Options
options.description: Enter the choices this Select can offer, separated by commas.

target.title: Add to a device?
target.description: Create this as its own new device, or add it onto an existing Device Emulator device instead - the same as using that device's "Configure" option. No extra entry is created either way.

name.title: Name it
name.description: Suggested based on what you picked - change it if you'd like.

yaml_import.title: Import from YAML
yaml_import.description: Paste a top-level `name:` plus a `components:` list - each item needs a `device_type` (a real HA domain this integration supports) and, for domains that need one, `show_as` / `image_source` / `options`, exactly like the matching wizard step would ask for. Every item also accepts an optional `name:` to override its default label (e.g. "PIR" instead of the generic "Motion"), and Number/Text/Select/Date/Time/Date & Time accept the same config fields their matching Home Assistant Helper does - unit/min/max/step/mode for Number, min/max/pattern/mode for Text, an `initial` starting value for any of them. Creates a whole new composed device in one step. See the README for the full format and a worked example.

abort.already_configured: An emulated device with this domain, show-as, and name already exists.

init.title: Configure this device
init.description: Add a new entity to this device, import several at once from YAML, or remove one that's already here.

data.action: What do you want to do?

add.title: Add to this device
add.description: Pick another domain to add as an entity on this device - e.g. add a Battery sensor to make this device look battery-powered.

remove.title: Remove an entity
remove.description: Pick which entity to remove. Anything created alongside it (hidden helper switches, sensors, or buttons) is removed too.

show_as.title: Show as
show_as.description: This domain covers more than one real device class - pick which one to show it as.

image_source.title: Image source
image_source.description: Enter an image URL (http:// or https://), or a path relative to your www folder (served at /local/), e.g. "myphoto.jpg".

options.title: Options
options.description: Enter the choices this Select can offer, separated by commas.

import_yaml.title: Import entities from YAML
import_yaml.description: Paste a `components:` list (same format as the main flow's YAML import, including the optional per-item `name:` override and the Number/Text/Select/Date/Time/Date & Time helper-config fields - a top-level `name:` is accepted but ignored, since this device already has one) to add every entity in it onto THIS device in one step.
